record.one_liner: Ahrefs SEO platform: keyword, backlink, rank and site data via REST API v3 and a hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API v3 uses a Bearer API key created in Account settings / API keys; MCP uses a separate generated MCP key. Keys are created by workspace owners and admins.
record.access_notes: API v3 is for Lite and higher plans. Free and other plans only get a limited set of free test queries. Free and trial accounts cannot use the MCP server.
record.api_notes: REST API v3 with many Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer and other endpoints; API units are consumed per row and field. Custom endpoints are Enterprise only. Public and some other endpoints are free.
record.blocker_notes: Real API and MCP use needs a Lite or higher paid subscription. Free and trial accounts only get free test queries.

evidence.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans.
On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries.
Using API v3 from any of the above methods is possible for Lite and higher subscription plans
all new applications require a Lite or higher subscription for activation
Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
Create and manage existing API keys in Account settings / API keys.
All requests besides free test queries and the Rank Tracker, Management, Public and some other endpoints consume API units.
click "Generate MCP key" to create a new key.
